page.content:
Overland and maritime corridors that moved silk, faiths, and techniques across Eurasia.

How Silk Road connects

  • Location: Overland Silk Road — The oasis caravan chain is the overland half of the Silk Road.
  • Location: Maritime silk route — The monsoon sea lanes are the maritime half of the Silk Road.
  • Item: Silk — Chinese silk is the good that later named the whole network.

What is Silk Road?

The Silk Road is the modern name for the linked caravan and sea routes between China, Central Asia, Iran, India, and the Mediterranean. No single highway existed; oasis cities, empires, and monsoon shipping made the traffic.

Key threads lead to Overland Silk Road, Maritime silk route and Silk.
